resources.string: Allows a trusted companion app signed with the OmniDev key to send privileged commands to OmniCoreService, including shell execution and device-state queries. Never grant this to unknown apps.
Allows OmniDev to control compatible default launchers through a shared AIDL protocol.

OmniDev Workspace uses this service to read and interact with the screen semantically. The AI agent can see UI elements (buttons, text fields, labels) across all apps and perform actions like clicking, typing, and scrolling — without relying on fragile pixel coordinates. This enables intelligent, context-aware automation.
